title: Schedule X and Narcotic Drug Control
content:
SOP: Schedule X and Narcotic Drug Control (SOP-PHM-002)
DEPARTMENT: Pharmacy
VERSION: 2.8
ROLES: pharmacist, doctor, nurse
PURPOSE: Statutory double-lock storage and physical ampoule return verification.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Schedule X and Narcotic Drug Control in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Schedule X and Narcotic Drug Control in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Schedule X and Narcotic Drug Control in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Schedule X and Narcotic Drug Control in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Schedule X and Narcotic Drug Control in full compliance with Pharmacy hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Pharmacy.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-PHM-002 Schedule X and Narcotic Drug Control v2.8, Section 4
